tool_arguments.prompt:
Create NEW hand-painted pose drawings from scratch, using the attached adopted neutral solely as exact character identity and drawing-style reference. This is a production sprite image, not a character redesign. Genuine transparent RGBA background. Make a TALL PORTRAIT canvas (1024x1536 or larger native portrait) with EXACTLY THREE separate complete drawings in ONE VERTICAL COLUMN, top/middle/bottom in the order below; each drawing large, centered in its own equally sized band, with generous transparent gutter and padding. No panel boxes, letters, labels, floor, shadow, colored backdrop, effect/speed lines, sparkles, water or props. Preserve the reference warm brown contour, same thin-to-medium edge, simple dot eyes, soft watercolor/paper texture contained entirely within painted silhouette, color blocks, head/body proportions and simplification. Do not become realistic, do not add costume or human limbs. Golden brown elongated fish with small brown spots, short mouth barbels, round dorsal and pectoral fins and rounded spotted fan tail. The three poses must have the same anatomical size and stationary support/body center; do not fit them independently or enlarge quieter poses. Show every appendage without clipping or overlap with other rows.
1. cheer: Friendly celebration with existing paired pectoral fins/flippers opening a little; no added limbs.
2. species_a: Keep the same side-facing simplified fish body and gently bend the existing caudal peduncle/tail fin a little upward.
3. species_b: The same single tail fin sweeps slightly downward, while head/body centre remain stable and all existing fins stay attached.
